model_status: Frozen; coefficients unchanged from the development model
original_target: Contemporaneous sarcopenia in the frozen CHARLS development framework
intended_use: Research screening and risk enrichment; not a stand-alone diagnosis
interpretation_boundary: The logistic probability is calibrated only for the original frozen sarcopenia target. Other post-freeze muscle/sarcopenia phenotypes were evaluated as construct-spectrum outcomes and do not have phenotype-specific calibrated probabilities from this equation.

formula.important_note: Legacy internal z_ variable prefixes do NOT indicate z-score standardization. No mean/SD or median/IQR standardization is applied before the equation.

qc_note: The 8-IQR values are frozen development-domain QC/applicability boundaries, not clinical reference intervals and not scaling constants.
notes: Enter raw laboratory values in the specified units; logarithmic transformations are applied internally.
Creatinine, triglycerides, CRP, glucose and HbA1c must be greater than zero.
No universal diagnostic or treatment cutoff is proposed.
The calculator implements the frozen equation only and does not refit or recalibrate the model.
The score does not replace direct assessment of muscle strength, muscle quantity or physical performance.
